title: Total time correct
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for total motion time must be 11.2 s.

title: Speed at B correct
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for speed at point B must be 16 m/s.

title: Deceleration magnitude identified
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the deceleration magnitude on the horizontal section from the given data.

title: Acceleration magnitude identified
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the acceleration magnitude on the incline from the given data.

title: Time split equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the correct equation relating the acceleration and deceleration phases using the velocity at a known time (e.g., 9 s).

title: Velocity-time relation used
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the kinematic equation v = u + at for both motion segments.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for the deceleration in equations, treating it as positive acceleration.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student's working shows consistent use of SI units (m/s, s, m/s²).
